Class UpdateCommands

java.lang.Object
databaseController.UpdateCommands
public class UpdateCommands extends Object
Handles all SQL UPDATE operations in the database. This class is responsible for updating reservations, members, tables, visits, bills, waiting list entries, and restaurant configuration.

    • updateVisit

      public static boolean updateVisit(common.BistroMessage toUpdate, ServerFrameController guiController)
      Updates visit status/timestamps based on the Action provided in the message. Handles START_VISIT (sets start_time) and BILL_PAID (sets end_time and inactive).
      Parameters:
      toUpdate - BistroMessage object containing the Action (START_VISIT/BILL_PAID) and the Visit object
      guiController - reference to the server GUI controller for logging errors
      Returns:
      true on success, false on failure or invalid data

    • updateWaitingListStatus

      public static boolean updateWaitingListStatus(int waitingId, String status, int tableId, ServerFrameController guiController)
      Updates a waiting list entry with an assigned table and status. Used when notifying a waiting customer that their table is ready.
      Parameters:
      waitingId - the ID of the waiting list entry
      status - the new status (e.g., "notified", "seated")
      tableId - the ID of the table assigned to the visit
      guiController - reference to the server GUI controller for logging errors
      Returns:
      true on success, false otherwise

    • updateVisitInWaitingList

      public static dataLayer.Visit updateVisitInWaitingList(dataLayer.Visit toUpdate, ServerFrameController guiController)
      Updates a waiting list entry to 'seated' status. This effectively moves the customer from the waiting state to an active visit.
      Parameters:
      toUpdate - the visit object containing the waiting ID
      guiController - reference to the server GUI controller for logging errors
      Returns:
      the updated Visit object on success, or null on failure
